# Outlay Grants

> Federal grants open now, searchable by deadline, award size and who can apply. Free, updated daily from Grants.gov data.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Data pages (rebuilt daily)
- [Federal Grants Closing Soon (Oct 2026): Deadlines Coming Up](https://outlaygrants.com/closing-soon/): Federal Grants Closing Soon: 200 open; 200 close within 30 days (soonest Oct 27, 2026). Median max award $900,000. Free, updated daily from Grants.gov.
- [Federal Grants Open Now (Oct 2026): All Opportunities by Deadline](https://outlaygrants.com/open-now/): Federal Grants Open Now: 1,453 open; 201 close within 30 days (soonest Oct 27, 2026). Median max award $750,000. Free, updated daily from Grants.gov.
- [Federal Grants Over $1 Million: Open Now (Oct 2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/over-1-million/): Federal Grants Over $1 Million: 290 open; 66 close within 30 days (soonest Oct 28, 2026). Median max award $3,475,000. Free, updated daily from Grants.gov.
- [Federal Grants by Agency](https://outlaygrants.com/agency/): Open U.S. federal grants grouped by the agency that offers them (75 agencies with 2+ open grants), with counts. Updated daily from Grants.gov.
- [Federal Grants by Category](https://outlaygrants.com/category/): Open U.S. federal grants grouped by funding category (23 categories), with the number of open opportunities in each. Updated daily from Grants.gov.
- [Weekly stats: federal grant opportunities](https://outlaygrants.com/stats/): As of Oct 26, 2026, our daily copy of Grants.gov (U.S. federal government) lists 1,457 open grants. 42 close within 7 days and 35 were posted in the l
- [Free downloads: deadline calendar, CSV and embed](https://outlaygrants.com/data/): Free downloads of open federal grant opportunities deadlines: subscribe to an .ics calendar, get a daily CSV, or embed the next 10 deadlines on your site.

## About the data
- Source: [Grants.gov (U.S. federal government)](https://www.grants.gov/)
- Licence: U.S. government work; public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105)
- Last data refresh: 2026-10-26
- Updated once a day from the official public data. Unofficial; always confirm details on the official notice before applying or bidding.

## Guides
- [SBIR Grants: How to Apply in 6 Steps (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/sbir-grants-how-to-apply-in-6-steps-2026/): SBIR grants for 2026: registration order (SAM.gov, SBA Company Registry, agency portals), Phase I and II amounts, and how to write and submit a proposal.
- [Grants for Veterans to Start a Business: 5 Options (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/grants-for-veterans-to-start-a-business-5-options-2026/): Grants for veterans to start a business are rare. Compare 5 real options (federal grants, VA VR&E, state grants, SBA loans) with Grants.gov steps.
- [SAM.gov Registration Renewal: 5 Steps Before It Expires](https://outlaygrants.com/sam-gov-registration-renewal-5-steps-before-it-expires/): SAM.gov registration renewal is free and due every 365 days. Learn the 60/30/15-day timeline, the 5 renewal steps, how to check status and what a lapse does.
- [Grants for Nonprofits Without 501c3: 4 Paths Compared](https://outlaygrants.com/grants-for-nonprofits-without-501c3-4-paths-compared/): Grants for nonprofits without 501c3 status: compare fiscal sponsorship, government status, pending Form 1023 and partners, with IRS numbers and steps.
- [Single Audit Threshold 2026: 3 Steps to Check Your Status](https://outlaygrants.com/single-audit-threshold-2026-3-steps-to-check-your-status/): Single audit threshold 2026: $1,000,000 in federal awards expended. Use this 3-step check, Type A table and FAC deadline to see if you owe one.
- [Grants.gov Workspace: Create and Submit in 5 Steps (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/grants-gov-workspace-create-and-submit-in-5-steps-2026/): Grants.gov Workspace in 5 steps: create it from Apply Now, add participants, assign an AOR, run Check Application, Sign and Submit before the deadline.
- [Indirect Cost Rate De Minimis: 15% Election in 4 Steps](https://outlaygrants.com/indirect-cost-rate-de-minimis-15-election-in-4-steps/): The indirect cost rate de minimis is now up to 15% of MTDC, not 10%. See who can elect it, how to calculate it, and how to document the election.
- [UEI Number Lookup: Free SAM.gov Search in 3 Steps](https://outlaygrants.com/uei-number-lookup-free-sam-gov-search-in-3-steps/): UEI number lookup made simple: search any organization's UEI free on SAM.gov with no login, find your own UEI, and know when you need to sign in.
- [Grants.gov vs SAM.gov: Registration Order in 4 Steps (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/grants-gov-vs-sam-gov-registration-order-in-4-steps-2026/): Grants.gov vs SAM.gov: see the correct registration order—SAM.gov issues your UEI and active status first, then Grants.gov unlocks applications. Follow the 4 steps, timing, and common fixes.
- [Federal Grant vs Cooperative Agreement: Table + NOFO Steps](https://outlaygrants.com/federal-grant-vs-cooperative-agreement-table-nofo-steps/): Federal grant vs cooperative agreement compared side by side: funding control, reporting burden and eligibility, plus steps to spot the type in any NOFO.
- [SF-424 Instructions: Field-by-Field Table and Steps (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/sf-424-instructions-field-by-field-table-and-steps-2026/): SF-424 instructions in plain English: what to type in all 21 fields from your SAM.gov profile, the district format, field 19-21 picks, and common fixes.
- [How to Write Grants for Nonprofits: Federal Proposal Guide](https://outlaygrants.com/how-to-write-grants-for-nonprofits-federal-proposal-guide/): Learn how to write grants for nonprofits the way federal reviewers score them: needs statement, goals, budget narrative, and Grants.gov submission steps.
- [Small Business Grants for Women: Federal Options (2026)](https://outlaygrants.com/small-business-grants-for-women-federal-options-2026/): Small business grants for women from the federal government are limited. Learn which SBA programs, SBIR/STTR awards, and WOSB certification apply to you.
- [Federal Government Grant Application Guide: Small Business](https://outlaygrants.com/how-to-apply-for-grants-for-small-business-2026-guide/): How to apply for a federal government grant application as a small business in 2026: register on SAM.gov, get a UEI, and submit via Grants.gov on time.
- [Check SAM Registration Status: SAM.gov Guide & Lookup](https://outlaygrants.com/how-to-check-sam-gov-registration-status-step-by-step/): Check SAM.gov registration status with the Entity Status tool, public search, or Workspace, and learn what Active, Inactive, and Submitted mean.
